description: This file defines the LeaveRequestComment class, which represents comments related to leave requests within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes properties for comment details, references to related leave request, user, and employee entities, and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: LeaveRequestComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a comment on a leave request in OrangeHRM, with properties for ID, associated leave request, creation timestamp, creator (user or employee), and comment text.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the comment.

methods.name: setLeaveRequest
methods.description: Associates a leave request with this comment.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Gets the creation timestamp of the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Gets the user who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who created the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Gets the employee who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee who created the comment.
